_provenance.audit_items: A2-01 (M5) full-support Rayleigh-Ritz; B2 one-node deficit on the ring; SOTA1-02 W_1; D4 leak scores vs L1 across truncations
_provenance.system: L=6 doped (2,2) Hubbard ring, PBC, current probe J (spectral_lanczos basis); dense ED
_provenance.scope: Exact classical numerics; no sampling, no device data. tau_k is the deployed rule evaluated on each U state (local-estimator variance, N_s=5e4, assumed 2% bias, z=1.96); the RR residuals are deterministic.

definitions.Delta_k: m_k - mbar_k, m_k = <J psi0|(H-E0)^k|J psi0>, mbar_k = <Pi phi_S|(H_S-e0)^k|Pi phi_S>
definitions.leak_score: Delta_k / m_k (deterministic; its tolerance is numerical, not shot noise)
definitions.rel_L1: int |A_RR - A| d omega / int A d omega, Lorentzian eta = 0.15 t, trapezoid on the stated grid
definitions.W1: Wasserstein-1 between the m0-normalized exact and RR measures (integral of |F - F_RR|)

U3.full_line_definition: int_{-400}^{400} |A_RR - A| d omega / m0 (grid step 1e-3 t)

one_node_krylov_m2_deficit.note: one Lanczos node = one pole at m1/m0 with weight m0; mbar_2 = m1^2/m0, deficit m0 Var_A. It can exceed the 2% bias budget b and still pass, because tau_2 = 1.96 sqrt(shot^2 + (b m2)^2) >= 3.92% of m2

verdicts.tau_rule: deployed rule on the exact U/t=4 state (z=1.96, N_s=5e4, 2% bias)
verdicts.note: Noise-free. Oracle: |m_k - mbar_k| <= tau_k for k <= 2 with exact m_k (the Appendix-B scan). Shared state: |mhat_k - mbar_k| <= tau_k, mhat_k = <0_S|O_k|0_S> (tau_k as a convention). Leak score: |Delta_k/mhat_k| against the numerical tolerance LEAK_TOL.
